title: Do the Right Thing
events_chronological: On the hottest morning of the year the disc jockey Senor Love Daddy opens his broadcast from a storefront window on the block.
Mookie gets out of bed at his sister Jade's flat and goes to work delivering pizzas.
Sal opens the pizzeria with his sons Pino and Vito, and Pino says he hates the neighbourhood and everyone in it.
Da Mayor buys his first beer of the day and is scolded for it by Mother Sister from her window.
Buggin Out complains that Sal's wall of photographs has only Italians on it and asks why there are no black faces.
Sal throws Buggin Out into the street, and Buggin Out starts calling for a boycott that nobody joins.
Radio Raheem walks the block with a boombox playing the same song at full volume all day.
Three older men sit under an umbrella opposite a Korean grocery and talk about the block from morning to night.
Smiley works the corner selling hand-coloured photographs of two murdered leaders.
Mookie tells Pino to his face that every one of his heroes is black.
Da Mayor pulls a child out of the path of a car, and Mother Sister softens towards him.
The fire hydrant is opened and the whole block plays in the water until a police car pulls up.
Radio Raheem and Buggin Out come into the pizzeria at closing with the radio at full volume, demanding the wall be changed.
Sal smashes the boombox with a baseball bat and the fight spills out into the street.
Police arrive and kill Radio Raheem with a chokehold in front of the entire block.
Mookie throws a rubbish bin through the pizzeria window and the crowd burns the place to the ground.
In the morning Mookie comes back for his week's wages, and he and Sal argue over the money in the ashes.
syuzhet_notes: The film covers one day on one block, cutting between a dozen people who are all outside in the same heat. The order is simply the order of the hours.
fabula_notes: Everything happens between one morning and the next. Where two strands share an hour, either ranking would do.
